question: Who is the current Directorate General of National Cadet Corps of India as of October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurbirpal Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lieutenant General Gurbirpal Singh has been appointed as the Director General of the National Cadet Corps (NCC) of India.
 
• He took over as the 34th Director General of NCC on 27th September 2021.
 
• Gurbirpal Singh is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy and Indian Military Academy.
 
• He has held various prestigious command and staff appointments in his distinguished military career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Cadet Corps (NCC)**

 
 
• NCC is the largest uniformed youth organization in India.
 
• It aims to develop character, comradeship, discipline, a secular outlook, and the spirit of adventure among young citizens.
 
• The NCC provides exposure to the cadets in a wide range of activities, with a distinct emphasis on social services, discipline, and adventure training.
 
• The NCC motto is "Unity and Discipline".
 
 
 
• **Roles and Responsibilities of DG NCC**
 
 
• The Director General of NCC is responsible for the overall administration and coordination of the NCC activities across India.
 
• The DG NCC oversees the training and development programs for cadets.
 
• The DG ensures that the NCC activities align with the objectives of the organization and the national interest.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility for NCC**
 
 
• Students from schools and colleges are eligible to join NCC.
 
• Cadets can join NCC as Junior Division/Wing (for school students) or Senior Division/Wing (for college students).
 
• There are specific enrollment periods and cadets must meet physical and educational criteria.
